atomicity: Each individual file replacement is atomic; a process crash is not an all-files transaction. Re-running is idempotent.

later_reported_archive_gap.meaning: Later reported archive had 2787 entries versus 2455 available files. The difference includes 34 reported repository dependencies; it is not a claim of 332 files under the literature prefix. No missing path list is invented, and this comparison does not claim recovery of all later work.

precondition_scope: Every touched path is checked against its exact before or after digest and mode. No claim is made about unrelated existing checkout files.
